messages:
Ava: Taking over night bridge at 20:00 PT. Quick access sanity check before I go primary: PagerDuty? Grafana? AWS roles? Also want easy links to runbooks.

Ravi: You're good for PagerDuty (primary) and Grafana viewer. AWS role kick requires that you have `redwood-oncall` in your SSO entitlements — I don't think you have it yet. I'll leave PD escalation notes in the handoff.

Ava: I can see PD but not the escalation policy edit page. I can ack/incidents fine. Grafana: dashboards load but I can't see service-level alert groups.

Ravi: That means you're missing the grafana org role 'oncall-ops'. I'll grant temp for the shift. I'll also add you to AWS SSO group `oncall-ops` which gives `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall`. Should be visible in the console within a few mins.

oncall-bot: Incident rota updated: Liam promoted to secondary for tonight (20:00–04:00). PagerDuty primary: Ava. PagerDuty secondary: Liam. (<https://rota.redwood.internal/2026/shift/2065432199>)

Liam: I'll be reachable via DM and on pager. Happy to pick up if anything noisy shows up.

Ravi: Granting Grafana role now: `iamctl grant grafana-role --user ava --role oncall-ops` (done)

Ravi: AWS SSO invite sent. If you don't see it, open https://sso.redwood.cloud/app and refresh. If SSO still missing, run:
```
aws sso login --profile redwood-oncall
aws sts get-caller-identity
```

Ava: Confirmed Grafana access. AWS shows role now. Can assume `Redwood-Oncall` — sts identity checks good.

Ravi: PagerDuty note: escalation policy set to Pager->SMS for first 2 minutes, then phone. Route: `production-latency`. I left a pinned note in PD with mitigation steps (restart autoscaler, scale frontend pool to +2).

Ava: Thanks. Two quick questions: 1) If I need to rotate a key or revoke access for someone overnight, is there an emergency flow? 2) Where's the "runbook pointer" for service owner contacts?

Ravi: 1) Emergency revocation: open #eng-security and tag @security-ops. They can revoke SSO groups immediately. For PD user disable, use Admin -> Users -> Disable. 2) Runbook links: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/handoff-checklist and https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/contact-roster (pinned in this thread)

Ava: Copy. Pinned the runbook links and added a short contact blurb for the night. Going primary now — ping me if you notice any gaps. :rocket:
